questions.question: My father reads ___ Hindu every morning.
questions.explanation: The newspaper's established name is 'The Hindu'.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I read the Times of India.
I read a Times of India.
I read an Times of India.
I read Times of India newspaper without any article.
questions.correctAnswer: I read the Times of India.
questions.explanation: The newspaper's conventional name is 'The Times of India'.

questions.question: We visited ___ Red Fort during our trip to Delhi.
questions.explanation: The Red Fort is an established monument name that takes 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Buckingham Palace is in London.
A Buckingham Palace is in London.
An Buckingham Palace is in London.
questions.explanation: Many buildings and palaces named after a person or place do not take 'the'.

questions.question: She studies at ___ University of Delhi.
questions.explanation: Names formed with 'University of...' commonly take 'the'.

questions.question: Which newspaper name is conventionally used with 'the'?
The tourists admired ___ Gateway of India.
questions.explanation: The established monument name is 'the Gateway of India'.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The Oxford University is in England.
An Oxford University is in England.
A Oxford University is in England.
questions.explanation: When the proper name is 'Oxford University', it is used without 'the'.

questions.question: He works for ___ United Nations.
questions.explanation: The name of this international organisation conventionally takes 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the article correctly?
options: We visited Taj Mahal without an article.
questions.explanation: The established name of the monument is 'the Taj Mahal'.

questions.question: She works at ___ World Health Organization.
questions.explanation: The name of the organisation conventionally takes 'the'.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The Parliament of India is located in New Delhi.
A Parliament of India is located in New Delhi.
An Parliament of India is located in New Delhi.
Parliament of India is located in New Delhi without an article.
questions.correctAnswer: The Parliament of India is located in New Delhi.
questions.explanation: The descriptive institutional name 'the Parliament of India' takes 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Eiffel Tower attracts many visitors.
An Eiffel Tower attracts many visitors.
A Eiffel Tower attracts many visitors.
Eiffel Tower attracts many visitors without an article.
questions.correctAnswer: The Eiffel Tower attracts many visitors.
questions.explanation: The established name of this landmark is conventionally used with 'the'.
